integrity: Analytical proof accompanies independently implemented deterministic checks; numeric tests are supplemental and no independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Comparison of exactly two prescribed, equally timed rain-depth schedules in a hypothetical instantaneous exponential power-law wash-off model. Not global optimality over all schedules; not empirically calibrated, not field-validated; stationary retained stock rather than total runoff export. Full text of the motivating article was unavailable for direct examination, and historical priority remains provisional.
title: A sharp storm-concentration crossover in periodic surface-pollutant wash-off
